title: Openings For Product Manager @ TAO Digital Solutions
Technical Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Join Nokia's Broadband Access Networks team to validate and automate testing of next\-generation broadband solutions. Apply your networking expertise and Python automation skills to ensure high\-quality software delivery and customer success.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* 
+ Design and execute test cases for broadband access network products.
+ Build and maintain test environments for functional and regression testing.
+ Validate Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features and protocols.
+ Analyze test results, identify defects, and drive issue resolution.
+ Develop and enhance automation scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
+ Execute performance and traffic validation using industry test tools.
+ Collaborate with development teams to improve product quality.
+ Support delivery milestones in a fast\-paced and agile environment.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You Have:**
* Graduate or Postgraduate in Engineering stream with 7 plus years of experience in L2, L3 Datacom / Protocol testing (e.g., VLAN, xSTP, IGMP, ARP, 802\.1x, QoS, DHCP, PPPoE, IPV6\).
* Proficient in test automation using Python and manual testing practices.
* Hands\-on experience with traffic generators like Spirent, IXIA, or PCTA.
* Skilled in analyzing, reproducing, and resolving complex system\-level issues.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Prior work experience in any of Fiber / EPON / GPON / IPDSLAM / FTTH product lines will be added advantage
* Automation with Python will be desirable along with good debugging skills.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits in India:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
* Health and well\-being support – medical insurance for you and your family, health check\-ups, life and accident insurance, well\-being programs, and employee resource groups
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave based on eligibility
* Personal Support Service 24/7 – a confidential support channel open to all Nokia employees and their families in challenging situations
* Career growth \& mobility – technical career paths, job rotations, international assignments, and relocation support
* Continuous learning – technical certifications, mentoring programs, coaching, and digital learning platforms
* Opportunities to innovate and contribute through Nokia’s research and development environment
* Recognition programs that celebrate outstanding contributions
* Workplace support – ergonomic working support and mobile device programs based on eligibility

title: Store / Product Data Mapping Executive
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented Store / Product Data Mapping Executive to support automotive parts data management, attribute mapping, product categorization, and data quality activities. The ideal candidate should have good analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work with large volumes of product and part-level data. Key Responsibilities Perform Interchange Mapping for automotive parts and identify equivalent/replacement parts. Conduct Part Analysis and collect relevant product attributes. Research and collect Attribute List of Values (LOV) based on product requirements. Perform Attribute Definition and maintain accurate attribute information. Work on Parts Category Mapping and ensure products are assigned to the correct categories. Perform ACES Mapping and maintain accurate vehicle/part fitment data. Handle NAPA Mapping and NAPA Net-related data changes. Perform PHDB Clean-Up and identify/correct data inconsistencies. Conduct Digital Asset Research and identify relevant product images/assets. Work on Dorman Attributes and ensure required product information is captured accurately. Support STIBO Service activities related to product data management. Identify missing, incorrect, or duplicate data and perform necessary corrections. Follow defined data quality standards and ensure accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve data-related queries and issues. Meet daily/weekly productivity and quality targets. Required Skills Good knowledge of MS Excel and data management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail. Ability to work with large volumes of data. Good understanding of product/parts data and categorization . Ability to perform online research and validate product information. Good written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to learn automotive aftermarket terminology and data standards. Preferred Skills Experience in automotive aftermarket / automotive parts data . Knowledge of ACES, PIES, NAPA, Dorman or similar automotive data standards. Experience with STIBO or Product Information Management (PIM) systems. Experience in product attribute mapping, catalog management, or data cleansing. Knowledge of automotive parts interchange and fitment data will be an added advantage. Experience 14 years of experience in Data Management, Product Data, Catalog Management, Data Mapping, or a related field.

Key Skills: Product Management,Data Mapping,Management,Mapping,Stores,Data

title: Group Product Manager
description:
Group Product Manager - Operator & Site Applications Location: Chennai, India Employment Type: Full-Time, Senior Leadership Job Summary We are seeking a high-caliber Group Product Manager - Operator & Site Applications to serve as a pivotal strategic and operational leader in our Chennai office. In this role, you will elevate product management practice maturity, drive execution rigor, and champion global non-functional requirements (NFRs) across our application suite-including our flagship V3 Program. Acting as the bridge between executive vision in the US, program leadership in New Zealand, and engineering teams in Chennai, you will lead local product teams while simultaneously driving site leadership initiatives to foster an outcome-oriented, collaborative tech hub. Key Responsibilities Product Practice & Execution Leadership Directly manage and mentor Chennai-based Product Managers and Product Owners, cultivating modern, outcome-focused product practices. Maintain seamless two-way communication between global sites (US/NZ) and Chennai, ensuring cross-location alignment and high-quality software delivery. Drive workload balancing, continuous skill development, and strict process adherence across all local software streams. Product Ownership - Software NFRs Drive strategic execution for global Software Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) across the Operator & Site Applications portfolio. Supportability & Diagnostics: Establish diagnostic tools and supportability frameworks to minimize field troubleshooting overhead. Cybersecurity & Privacy: Enforce security standards (RBAC, secure APIs, encryption) and data privacy across local application releases. Licensing & Access: Support commercial licensing services, enabling flexible feature-flagging and software activations. Deployment Packaging: Oversee automated, zero-downtime deployment pipelines for application packages and cloud components. Site Leadership & Operations Act as the on-site executive voice, driving alignment with global corporate goals and building a strong local culture across PX, IT, Finance, and Engineering. Oversee site operations, vendor contracts, facilities, compliance, and crisis management to ensure zero operational disruptions. Partner with talent acquisition to position the Chennai office as a top-tier tech destination and attract industry-leading talent. Key Performance Indicators & Success Metrics Delivery Cohesion: Achieve 95% on-time release alignment between Chennai and NZ software streams for the V3 Program, maintaining an 80%+ sprint predictability score. NFR Compliance: Drive compliance with global security, telemetry, and API scale standards, achieving a 25% reduction in field troubleshooting time through automated diagnostics. Team & Talent Growth: Maintain local PM/PO attrition below 10% and keep time-to-hire under 4 months for open requisitions. Operational Excellence: Ensure 100% site compliance across legal, statutory, and HR frameworks with zero critical operational downtime. What We Are Looking For Proven Experience: Extensive background in senior product leadership managing PMs/POs in complex, enterprise-grade software environments. Cross-Functional & Global Alignment: Demonstrated success bridging distributed global teams across multiple time zones (specifically US/NZ/India). Technical Breadth: Strong grasp of platform architecture, cloud/API scalability, cybersecurity standards, and automated deployment pipelines. Site Management Capabilities: Experience managing operational, vendor, and culture-building responsibilities for a regional office hub.

title: Product Manager
description:
Engineering Manager Data Platform 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager Data Platform to lead our offshore Data Platform engineering team. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for the design, delivery, governance, and reliability of an enterprise data platform. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise across Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Collibra, along with proven experience managing data engineering teams and delivering complex enterprise data initiatives. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 815 data engineers, architects, and analysts. 
 Own sprint planning, backlog management, delivery cadence, and engineering execution. 
 Serve as the primary offshore point of contact for technical escalations and cross-functional dependencies. 
 Architect and evolve enterprise data platforms covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption. 
 Design and implement solutions using Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Snowflake. 
 Drive best practices for ETL/ELT, data modeling, data pipelines, performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 Lead data governance initiatives using Collibra, including data catalog, business glossary, lineage, and stewardship. 
 Establish data ownership, classification, access control, metadata, and data quality practices. 
 Collaborate with architecture, product, BI, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, and business teams. 
 Drive platform reliability, continuous improvement, security, and cloud cost optimization. 
 Communicate platform health, roadmap progress, risks, and delivery status to senior leadership. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or related technology roles. 
 3+ years of experience in Engineering Management or Team Lead roles. 
 Proven experience leading offshore/distributed engineering teams. 
 Experience owning or managing an enterprise cloud data platform in a production environment. 
 Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, and Azure Synapse Analytics. 
 Strong experience with Collibra and data governance. 
 Strong SQL and Python skills. 
 Experience with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling, and cloud data platforms. 
 Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows, dbt, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog. 
 Experience with MDM platforms such as Informatica MDM or Reltio. 
 Experience with Salesforce/CRM data integration. 
 Exposure to Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or streaming architectures. 
 Experience with data quality, lineage, metadata management, and regulatory requirements. 
 Work Location & Shift 
 Location: Chennai 
 Shift: 11:00 AM 8:00 PM 
 Work Model: Work from a U.S. Bank location 3 or more days per week 
 Notice Period: Candidates with less than 60 days notice preferred.Role & responsibilities
